versions.changelog:
Personal Understanding v2.2.0 is a major overhaul focusing on verbatim-first, traceable personal cognition and strict separation of technical vs. personal material.

- Every personal user message is now saved verbatim, before any summarizing or interpretation; originals are never overwritten.
- Derivation and closure rules ensure that captures move from raw to resolved with explicit, auditable status.
- Strictly segregates technical/configuration requests from personal archiving; technical actions never enter the personal record.
- Fact-handling hierarchy keeps raw user experience, user interpretations, model speculation, and unconfirmed material clearly separated.
- Records follow a unified "salience" axis—pivotal, key, supporting, passing—to indicate future importance, replacing all prior importance systems.
- Stronger checks, source handling, and finalization steps help prevent data loss, error, and mistaken attribution.
